description: Lambda-friendly job model and handlers: JobRepository (in-memory / DynamoDB) + JobDispatcher (thread / async Lambda invoke) behind the unchanged JobManager surface and API contract, worker Lambda handler, Mangum API handler, optional AgentCore entrypoint. Plan items 4-5, decisions D-M4-1, D-M4-2, D-M4-5, D-M4-9 in d:/github work/SDK workshop/.agents/tasks/heatwise-m4/plan.md. Depends on FEAT-001 (settings, dynamodb_schema, aws_fixtures, store factory).
steps: backend/api/jobs.py: keep `Job`, `TooManyJobs`, `FAILED_ERROR`. Add `JobRepository` ABC: `create(request, max_pending) -> Job` (raises TooManyJobs), `get(job_id) -> Job | None` (snapshot copy), `mark_running(job_id) -> Job | None` (None if the job is not queued), `mark_succeeded(job_id, report_id, report, duration_ms)`, `mark_failed(job_id, error, duration_ms)`. `InMemoryJobRepository(max_retained=200)` = today's dict + lock + `replace()` snapshots + eviction of oldest finished. `execute_job(job_id, repository, store, run_fn) -> None`: mark_running (return if None), time with perf_counter, `report = run_fn(job.request, job.job_id)`, save AssessmentRecord, mark_succeeded; on exception log with trace and mark_failed(FAILED_ERROR) and store nothing. `JobDispatcher` ABC `dispatch(job_id)` / `shutdown(wait)`; `ThreadDispatcher(execute, max_workers)` wrapping ThreadPoolExecutor(thread_name_prefix='heatwise-job').

JobManager: `__init__(run_fn, store, max_workers=2, max_pending=20, max_retained=200, repository=None, dispatcher=None)`; defaults InMemoryJobRepository + ThreadDispatcher calling execute_job. `submit` = repository.create then dispatcher.dispatch; a dispatch exception -> mark_failed(JobError(code='dispatch_failed', message=generic)) and return that snapshot. `get` = repository.get; if status succeeded and report is None and report_id set, fill `report` from `store.get(report_id).report`. `shutdown(wait)` delegates. `run_fn` signature is now `(request, session_id)`.

backend/api/app.py: `run_fn(req, session_id)` -> `factory(req).run(req.location, req.profile_as_community(), req.forecast_days, session_id=session_id)`; `create_app(settings=None, store=None, coordinator_factory=None, jobs=None)`; when jobs is None use `build_job_manager(settings, run_fn, store)` (memory+thread by default; job_store=dynamodb -> DynamoDbJobRepository(jobs_table_name, stale_after_seconds, ttl_days, region); job_dispatch=lambda -> LambdaDispatcher(worker_function_name); ValueError on missing names). Expose `make_run_fn(settings, coordinator_factory=None)` so the worker reuses it.

backend/tests/test_api.py `test_job_reads_are_snapshots`: change the local `def run_fn(req)` to `def run_fn(req, session_id=None)` and pass `session_id=session_id` through to `.run`; no other existing test changes.
backend/api/routes.py: jobs 404 detail -> 'No assessment job with this id.'; `APP_VERSION` fallback order: installed dist version, env HEATWISE_VERSION, '0.0.0'.

New backend/api/dynamodb_jobs.py: `DynamoDbJobRepository(table_name, stale_after_seconds=420, ttl_days=7, client=None, region_name=None)`. Item: job_id, status, created_at (dynamodb_schema.ts), started_at, finished_at, duration_ms (string), report_id, error_code, error_message, request_json, pending_pk='pending' while queued/running, expires_at=epoch(now+ttl_days). create: count_pending = query PENDING_INDEX `pending_pk = :p AND created_at >= :cutoff` Select=COUNT (cutoff = now - stale_after_seconds) -> TooManyJobs at max_pending, then put_item with `attribute_not_exists(job_id)`. mark_running: update_item ConditionExpression `#s = :queued`, ConditionalCheckFailedException -> None. mark_succeeded/mark_failed: set fields and `REMOVE pending_pk`. get: rebuild Job (report=None); if queued/running and older than stale_after_seconds -> return a failed copy with JobError(code='assessment_timed_out', message generic). `LambdaDispatcher(function_name, client=None, region_name=None)`: `client.invoke(FunctionName=..., InvocationType='Event', Payload=json.dumps({'job_id': job_id}).encode())`, raise if StatusCode != 202.

New backend/lambda_worker.py: `handle(event, settings=None, coordinator_factory=None, repository=None, store=None)` validates `event['job_id']` against ^[0-9a-f]{32}$ (ValueError otherwise), builds repository (DynamoDbJobRepository from settings) and store (build_assessment_store) when not injected, then `execute_job(job_id, repository, store, make_run_fn(settings, coordinator_factory))`; returns {'job_id', 'status'}. Module-level `handler(event, context)` with lazily cached settings; logging.basicConfig at LOG_LEVEL.

New backend/lambda_api.py: `build_handler(settings=None, **create_app_kwargs)` -> `Mangum(create_app(settings, **create_app_kwargs), lifespan='off')`; module-level `handler(event, context)` builds once lazily (cold start) and delegates.

New backend/agentcore_handler.py: `run_assessment(payload, session_id=None, settings=None, coordinator_factory=None) -> dict`: body = payload.get('request', payload); `AssessmentRequest.model_validate(body)` (pydantic ValidationError propagates); coordinator from coordinator_factory or `default_coordinator_factory(settings)`; `report.model_dump(mode='json')`; stores nothing. New backend/agentcore_entry.py mirroring _reference/strands-workshop/samples/05-deploy/main.py: `from bedrock_agentcore.runtime import BedrockAgentCoreApp`; `app = BedrockAgentCoreApp()`; `@app.entrypoint def invoke(payload, context): return run_assessment(payload, getattr(context, 'session_id', None))`; `if __name__ == '__main__': app.run()`. Docstring: optional, not deployed, see docs/deployment.md.

New backend/tests/test_jobs_dynamodb.py (moto, fixtures from aws_fixtures): create/get queued view and request round trip; TooManyJobs at max_pending; a job with created_at older than stale_after is not counted and is read as failed/assessment_timed_out; mark_running succeeds once then returns None; finished job has no pending_pk and has expires_at; LambdaDispatcher with a stub client records FunctionName, InvocationType 'Event', payload {'job_id'}; TestClient over create_app(jobs=JobManager(..., repository=DynamoDbJobRepository, dispatcher=stub that calls execute_job inline)) returns JobView with the same keys as the memory path and the report filled from the DynamoDB store; dispatch failure -> failed/dispatch_failed.

New backend/tests/test_lambda_handlers.py: API Gateway HTTP API v2 events (version '2.0', routeKey '$default', rawPath, requestContext.http.method/sourceIp, headers, body, isBase64Encoded False) through `build_handler(make_settings(), coordinator_factory=..., jobs=...)`: GET /api/health -> 200 JSON with version; POST /api/assessments -> 202 with Location header; OPTIONS preflight with Origin http://localhost:5173 -> allow-origin header; unknown origin not allowed. Worker under moto with Settings(_env_file=None, agent_mode='offline', weather_provider='demo', job_store='dynamodb', assessment_store='dynamodb', session_storage='s3', bucket/table names): queued job -> handle -> succeeded, AssessmentRecord in the table, S3 keys under `sessions/session_<job_id>/`; second handle on the same job is a no-op; failing coordinator_factory -> failed with nothing stored; bad event -> ValueError.

New backend/tests/test_agentcore.py: run_assessment with offline/demo settings returns a dict with status 'complete' and report_id; payload wrapped as {'request': {...}} works too; extra key 'phone' raises ValidationError; `pytest.importorskip('bedrock_agentcore')` then importing backend.agentcore_entry exposes `app` and `invoke`.
acceptance_criteria: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` passes with all old tests and the new job/handler/AgentCore tests, 4 deselected, offline.
Default (memory + thread) behaviour and every existing test_api.py assertion are unchanged; JobView keys are identical on the DynamoDB path.
Worker handler is idempotent on duplicate delivery and never stores a record for a failed run.
No test calls real AWS or Bedrock (moto, stub Lambda client, ScriptedModel, demo weather).

findings: No new dependencies installed (uses mangum 0.22.0, moto 5.2.5, bedrock-agentcore 1.25.2, boto3/botocore 1.43.123 from FEAT-001). Handler paths for CDK (FEAT-003): API `backend.lambda_api.handler`, worker `backend.lambda_worker.handler`. Env the Lambdas read (Settings field names upper-cased): API needs JOB_STORE=dynamodb, JOBS_TABLE_NAME, JOB_DISPATCH=lambda, WORKER_FUNCTION_NAME, ASSESSMENT_STORE=dynamodb, ASSESSMENTS_TABLE_NAME, API_CORS_ORIGINS, AWS_REGION, optionally HEATWISE_VERSION, JOB_STALE_AFTER_SECONDS, JOB_TTL_DAYS, API_MAX_PENDING_JOBS; worker needs JOBS_TABLE_NAME, ASSESSMENT_STORE=dynamodb, ASSESSMENTS_TABLE_NAME, SESSION_STORAGE=s3, SESSION_BUCKET, SESSION_PREFIX, AGENT_MODE/BEDROCK_MODEL_ID, WEATHER_PROVIDER, AWS_REGION (the worker always uses DynamoDbJobRepository regardless of JOB_STORE). IAM actions actually used: API role -> jobs table dynamodb:PutItem, GetItem, UpdateItem (mark_failed on dispatch failure), Query on index/pending; assessments table GetItem, Query on index/by_created and index/by_location (and PutItem only if JOB_DISPATCH=thread, not used on AWS); lambda:InvokeFunction on the worker. Worker role -> jobs table GetItem, UpdateItem; assessments table PutItem (+ GetItem not required); S3 session bucket s3:GetObject, PutObject, DeleteObject, ListBucket under prefix sessions/ (Strands S3SessionManager); Bedrock per D-M4-7. Modules: backend/api/jobs.py now has Job, TooManyJobs, FAILED_ERROR, DISPATCH_FAILED_ERROR (code dispatch_failed), RunFn type, JobRepository ABC, InMemoryJobRepository(max_retained), execute_job(job_id, repository, store, run_fn), JobDispatcher ABC (dispatch, shutdown default no-op), ThreadDispatcher(execute, max_workers), JobManager(run_fn, store, max_workers, max_pending, max_retained, repository=None, dispatcher=None) with public attributes .repository/.dispatcher, and build_job_manager(settings, run_fn, store) (lives in jobs.py, lazy-imports dynamodb_jobs; ValueError naming JOBS_TABLE_NAME / WORKER_FUNCTION_NAME when missing). backend/api/dynamodb_jobs.py: DynamoDbJobRepository(table_name, stale_after_seconds=420, ttl_days=7, client=None, region_name=None), TIMED_OUT_ERROR (code assessment_timed_out), LambdaDispatcher(function_name, client=None, region_name=None) raising RuntimeError if StatusCode != 202. Jobs item duration_ms is stored as a DynamoDB N (consistent with the assessments store), expires_at as N epoch seconds; finish updates use `SET ... REMOVE pending_pk` with attribute_exists(job_id). backend/api/app.py: make_run_fn(settings, coordinator_factory=None) -> run_fn(req, session_id=None) passing session_id to coordinator.run; create_app(settings=None, store=None, coordinator_factory=None, jobs=None) (API path now uses session_id = job_id, so local API runs write coordinator sessions under SESSION_DIR, default .data/sessions). routes.py: job 404 detail 'No assessment job with this id.'; APP_VERSION fallback dist version -> env HEATWISE_VERSION -> '0.0.0'. New backend/lambda_api.py build_handler(settings=None, **create_app_kwargs) -> Mangum(..., lifespan='off') + lazy module handler; backend/lambda_worker.py handle(event, settings=None, coordinator_factory=None, repository=None, store=None) -> {'job_id','status'} (ValueError for non-dict/bad job_id) + handler(event, context) with cached settings and logging.basicConfig(force=True); backend/agentcore_handler.py run_assessment(payload, session_id=None, settings=None, coordinator_factory=None) -> report dict, stores nothing; backend/agentcore_entry.py app=BedrockAgentCoreApp(), @app.entrypoint invoke(payload, context) (must not go into the Lambda asset; the asset build should exclude or simply not need bedrock_agentcore since nothing imports agentcore_entry). test_api.py: only test_job_reads_are_snapshots run_fn signature changed.
